description: Local collection, file indexing, action extraction, and schedule storage helpers

components.agent_wrapper.py: HTTP(S)-validated collection pipeline: browser-use Agent, local Browser daemon/Vision, then static fetch fallback
components.action_extractor.py: Model-assisted action extraction with schedule persistence

limitations: browser-use autonomous collection requires a supported LLM key
daemon collection requires the Browser daemon to be started separately; static fetch remains the final fallback
generated Markdown reports are confined to ignored _runtime or OS temporary storage
